response.answer: A protected review hour lets auditors examine contested denials without routine interruptions, improving the chance of catching material issues before an appeal escalates. Routine queue questions can be held and summarized by a coordinator while the queue continues moving; only vulnerable-customer escalations, regulator requests, or data-security issues should interrupt because they can alter urgency or legal obligations. In one storm-damage appeal, focused review aligned the evidence and revealed an overlooked documented loss date, allowing the decision to be corrected before a longer customer appeal.
